newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila shares end slightly higher on late buying.
newsitem.headline: Manila shares end slightly higher on late buying.

text.p: * Petron, Ayala Corp nudge index up by 5.13 pts
Philippine shares closed slightly firmer after wallowing in negative territory through most of the session, brokers said.
"The market is still consolidating between 3,250 and 3,350. Today, it held above the 3,300 level," Rolando Pineda, chief operating officer of Tower Securities, said.
He said trading was initially focused on tertiary issues, but accumulation on select blue chips was apparent in the last hour.
